# ankra_project (Resource)

A project of the organisation: a team-sized scope for clusters, applications, environments, stack profiles, pipeline repositories and AI automations, each of which belongs to exactly one project. The counterpart of `ankra project create`, `rename` and `delete`. Managing projects needs the `projects.manage` permission, and projects must be turned on for the organisation.

Projects belong to the organisation, so this resource needs no provider `project_id`, however many projects the organisation has. Resources that live inside a project do: once the organisation has a second project, set the provider's `project_id` (an ID or a slug, such as `default`) for them, or give each of them its own `project_id` where it offers one.

**Destroy** deletes the project. The platform refuses to delete a project that still holds resources (move them with `ankra project move` first) and never deletes the organisation's default project. Members whose current project it was are pointed back at the default project, and tokens pinned to it stop working.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Projects belong to the organisation and need no provider project_id. Once
# the organisation has a second project, resources that are scoped to a
# project (and most others) do: set the provider's project_id, for example to
# "default".
provider "ankra" {
  project_id = "default"
}

resource "ankra_project" "platform" {
  name        = "Platform team"
  slug        = "platform"
  description = "Shared infrastructure clusters"
}

# Pin a CI token to the new project.
resource "ankra_service_token" "platform_ci" {
  name       = "platform-ci"
  role_slug  = "member"
  project_id = ankra_project.platform.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, at most 128 characters. Changing it renames the project in place.
- `slug` (String) Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63 characters, starting with a letter or digit. `default` is reserved. The platform never changes a slug (it ends up in kubeconfig entries, CLI selections and deep links), so changing it replaces the project, which the platform refuses while the project holds resources.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 2048 characters. Unset clears it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the project was created.
- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organisation's default project, which cannot be deleted. Only an imported default project reads `true`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Projects are imported by ID or by slug.
terraform import ankra_project.platform platform
```
